note: pwa_service_worker adds an experimental service worker with config object pwa_service_worker.config (urls_to_cache, urls_to_exclude default admin/.* and user/.*, offline_page default /offline, cache_version default 1, skip_waiting default false). Form at /admin/config/services/pwa/service-worker (route pwa_service_worker.config, permission administer pwa); routes /service-worker-data, /offline, /pwa/phone-home; four cache-list alter hooks. Depends on pwa. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real pwa_service_worker.config keys read/written via drush.

evals.prompt: Where are the PWA service worker's settings stored and at what admin path is its configuration form?
evals.expected_output: In the config object pwa_service_worker.config; the form is at /admin/config/services/pwa/service-worker (route pwa_service_worker.config, permission 'administer pwa').

evals.prompt: How does the PWA service worker handle being offline, and which config key sets the fallback page path (and its default)?
evals.expected_output: It serves an offline fallback page; the path is the 'offline_page' config key in pwa_service_worker.config, defaulting to /offline (also the pwa_service_worker.offline_page route).

evals.prompt: In pwa_service_worker, how can a custom module add extra URLs to the list the service worker caches on install, and which config key holds that list in the UI?
evals.expected_output: Implement hook_pwa_service_worker_cache_urls_alter(&$cacheUrls, &$cacheableMetadata) to add URLs; the same list is edited via the 'urls_to_cache' key in pwa_service_worker.config.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the PWA service worker's offline fallback page has been changed from its default. Inspect the live configuration and state the current offline page path.
evals.expected_output: pwa_service_worker.config offline_page is '/maintenance' (default '/offline'); read with `drush cget pwa_service_worker.config offline_page`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the PWA service worker cache version has been bumped. Inspect the live configuration and state the current cache_version value.
evals.expected_output: pwa_service_worker.config cache_version is '7' (default '1'); read with `drush cget pwa_service_worker.config cache_version`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the PWA service worker so its offline fallback page is '/sorry-offline'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set pwa_service_worker.config offline_page to '/sorry-offline' (e.g. drush cset pwa_service_worker.config offline_page /sorry-offline -y).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the PWA service worker so that an updated service worker activates immediately after installing (enable skip_waiting). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set pwa_service_worker.config skip_waiting to true (e.g. drush cset pwa_service_worker.config skip_waiting true -y).
